name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell at thigh level.
With a slight knee bend, hinge at the hips and lower the bar along your legs.
Descend until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive the hips forward to stand, squeezing the glutes. Distinct from Romanian — knees stay nearly straight.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Stiff-Leg Deadlift is an intermediate hip-hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed with a barbell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
